rule: accepted notice and rulings. Version-13 variant rows gain shape byte 2 (Record). A dense name column follows the variant field rows exactly when some decoded variant row has shape 2: each record variant's field names in variant-row and ordinal order, written as nominal field names are, with no count (the record variants' field ranges imply it). Only body_nodes() profiles write enum columns, so only they can write it; a packet without a record variant keeps its exact bytes. The declaration row keeps kind Variant: for a record variant it names the variant's type-namespace definition. The shape is the one source of the variant's namespace, Type for a record variant and Value for a unit or tuple variant, and each consumer re-derives it at its module binding rows, constructor applications and value cells. Names are validated as nominal field names are (validate_component), unique within their variant; a positional field carries no name. Body IR is unchanged: VariantAggregate lists fields in declaration order, IsVariant names the variant row and downcasts project Field { owner: variant row, ordinal }
